materials.heading: Walxaha caadiga ah
materials.lead: {count}-da walxood ee maktabadda caadiga ah ee Glazecalc, laga bilaabo feldspar-yada iyo dhoobada ilaa frit-yada iyo ilaha boron, mid kastaa leh falanqaynta oksaydhka iyo khataraha.
materials.intro: Hab kasta oo Glazecalc ku jira wuxuu isticmaali karaa walxahan. Bog kastaa wuxuu bixiyaa falanqaynta oksaydhka iyo qaybta UMF (unity molecular formula) ee Glazecalc ka shaqeeyo, khataraha sida maktabaddu u qorto, iyo meesha tirooyinku ka yimaadeen.
materials.careAbout: Ka hor intaadan taaban walax glaze kasta, akhri <mixing>Isku-darka ammaanka ah iyo hawo-wareejinta</mixing> iyo <home>Ha sumayn qoyskaaga</home>.
materials.own: Walxahaaga gaarka ah, ee akoonkaaga ku kaydsan, waxay ku jiraan <own>bogga Walxaha</own>. <cones>Shaxda cone-ka</cones> waxay liis gareysaa heerkulka cone-yada.

material.lead: Walax caadi ah oo ku jirta maktabadda Glazecalc: falanqaynta oksaydhka, qaybta UMF iyo khataraha.
material.analysisHeading: Falanqaynta oksaydhka iyo UMF (unity molecular formula)
material.analysisPercent: Glazecalc wuxuu hayaa falanqaynta walaxda {name} oo ah boqolkiiba miisaanka walaxda ceeriin. Qaybta UMF waa moles-ka oksaydh kasta ee ku jira xaddiga walaxda {name} ee haysta 1.0 mole oo flux ah, taasina waa sida Glazecalc ugu daro UMF-ta habka.
material.analysisMolecular: Glazecalc wuxuu hayaa falanqaynta walaxda {name} oo ah moles-ka oksaydh kasta oo la gubay qaacido kasta. Qaybta UMF waa moles-ka oksaydh kasta ee ku jira xaddiga walaxda {name} ee haysta 1.0 mole oo flux ah, taasina waa sida Glazecalc ugu daro UMF-ta habka.
material.noFlux: Walaxda {name} ma laha oksaydh flux ah, sidaas darteed qaybteeda UMF waa qaacido kasta sida loo qoray.
material.weightsNote: Miisaanka u dhigma waa garaamada walaxda {name} ee haysta 1.0 mole oo flux ah. Miisaanka kaddib gubidda waa inta ka hadha kaddib gubidda.
material.noAnalysis: Glazecalc ma xisaabin karin falanqayn walaxdan.
material.noHazards: Maktabaddu ma hayso qoraal khatar oo walaxdan ah. Eeg warqadda xogta badbaadada (SDS) ee alaab-qeybiyahaaga.
material.hasLead: Walaxdan waxaa ku jira oksaydhka rasaasta (lead, Pb), PbO.
material.care: Glazecalc wuxuu muujiyaa qoraalka khatarta sida diiwaanka maktabaddu u bixiyo. Ma aha qiimayn khatar oo dhammaystiran, sidaas darteed akhri warqadda xogta badbaadada (SDS) ee alaab-qeybiyahaaga. Ka hor intaadan taaban walax glaze kasta, akhri <mixing>Isku-darka ammaanka ah iyo hawo-wareejinta</mixing> iyo <home>Ha sumayn qoyskaaga</home>.
material.use: Ku dar walaxda {name} hab ku jira xisaabiyaha Glazecalc si aad u aragto waxa ay ku samayso UMF-ta glaze-ka.

cones.heading: Shaxda cone-ka: cone-yada Orton iyo SK
cones.lead: Heerkulka Glazecalc u isticmaalo cone-yada pyrometric ee Orton iyo SK, °C iyo °F, oo leh xawaaraha kululaynta ay u yihiin iyo meesha tiro kastaa ka timid.
cones.intro: Cone-yadu waxay cabbiraan shaqada kulaylka (heatwork), oo ah heerkulka iyo waqtiga oo wada jira, ma aha heerkulka oo keliya. Heerkulka cone-ku wuxuu ku xiran yahay sida degdegga ah ee kiln-ku (foornada dhoobada lagu dubo) u kululaado dhammaadka, sidaas darteed shax kasta oo hoose waxay sheegaysaa xawaaraheeda. Kiln-ka dhig witness cone oo akhri, wax kasta oo shaxdu sheegto. <firing>Sida cone-yada loo doorto, loo dhigo loona akhriyo</firing> waxay ku jirtaa hagaha gubidda.
cones.ortonCaption: Cone-yada Orton, 022 ilaa 15: cone-yo waaweyn oo lagu kululeeyay {rate} °C saacaddii ({rateF} °F saacaddii)
cones.above: Orton waxay sidoo kale samaysaa cone-yo 16 ilaa 42. Orton ma daabaco heerkul ay leeyihiin, shax aan helnayna mid ma bixiso, sidaas darteed midna lama muujin: {list}.
cones.publishedIntro: Shaxda Orton ee {year} ee cone-yada 022 ilaa 14 waxay bixisaa heerkul xawaare kululayn kasta, 100 °C-da ugu dambeysa ee gubidda. Tirooyinku wax yar ayay kaga duwan yihiin shaxda kore, oo Glazecalc u isticmaalo hubinta cone-ka.
cones.publishedCaption: Cone-yada Orton, 022 ilaa 14: heerkulka °{unit}, nooca cone-ka iyo xawaaraha kululaynta
cones.largeDiffers: Cone-yada waaweyn ee 13 iyo 14 si kale ayaa loo sameeyaa, waxayna leeyihiin heerkul u dhigma oo u gaar ah.
cones.skCaption: Cone-yada SK, 022 ilaa 20: heerkulka magac ahaaneed ee cone-ku ku foorarmo (JIS R 8101)
cones.skIntro: Cone-yada SK (Seger) waxaa Japan lagu iibiyaa heerka (standard) {standard}. Tirooyinku waa heerkulka tixraaca ee heerka sida iibiyuhu u daabaco, ma aha waxa kiln-ku muujin doono.
cones.skSource: Isha: {seller}, shaxda heerkulka caadiga ah ee cone-ku ku foorarmo.
